# Health packs locations

Source: [1976](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/1976); edited 2023-09-01. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-1976-n1"></a>

- Catalog stores small/large health-pack world positions as native Vector arrays, generally Global.A and Global.B respectively.

<a id="wiki-1976-n2"></a>

- Positions are organized by gameplay mode and map/submap, including seasonal variants; same map normal/Deathmatch pack sets differ and must not be merged by map name alone.

<a id="wiki-1976-n3"></a>

- Coverage includes practice/Assault-era maps, Control submaps, Hybrid, Escort, Flashpoint (New Junk City/Suravasa), CTF Busan variants and Deathmatch maps. Some sections contain only small or only large packs.

<a id="wiki-1976-n4"></a>

- Original attribution is Teawy's Blizzard-forum vector-data post; this is measurement data rather than an engine query API.

<a id="wiki-1976-n5"></a>

- Practice Range small-pack sample is syntactically malformed: Array lacks final closing parenthesis before semicolon.

Source limitations:

- September 2023 archive; map reworks/new-map coverage unverified, without per-map measurement dates/tolerance.

- Practice Range heading encompasses several Assault maps until Control heading; taxonomy needs correction.

- Aliases/typos include Lijang and Kanazenka; normalize with provenance.

- Oasis University Deathmatch has two near-identical large-pack coordinates; potential duplicate needs testing.

- Every source coordinate block was read; data catalog assessed without reproducing every coordinate in ledger.
